sections.title: Everything from this unit, in one visit
sections.content: A family story just chains what you already know from this unit: possessive family words, -a/-e/-ja/-je and -i for "his/her", -nál/-nél for "at someone's place", and the family-life verbs from the last lesson.

items.spanish: Károly apja és anyja kedves és vicces.
items.english: Károly's father and mother are kind and funny.

sections.content: kedves and vicces are straight from A1's Describing People unit — a family story is a natural place to reuse personality words you already own, on people you haven't described yet.
